key_highlights: ASX set to fall sharply on Wall Street decline; oil near US$100 as Iran war escalates and Hormuz disruptions hit global trade
Iron ore in sustained downtrend ('drowning, not waving'); China-US tensions intensify, pressuring BHP, RIO, FMG
RBA perceived as choosing recession path; Australian business conditions weakest since pandemic
Home buyer sentiment collapses; high-end property sees steepest falls while affordable segment resilient
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic liquidity concerns
WA gold sector active: multiple high-grade hits and drill-outs (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway, Forrestania)
Qantas $35m redundancy payout signals ongoing airline sector restructuring
ATO escalates tax dispute with Big Tech; energy transition strained by AI data centre demand

sectors.trend: Severely negative. Iron ore in structural downtrend with China demand weakening; copper and gold provide partial offset. Flagship expanding copper exposure; WA gold juniors active.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face sustained pressure. Gold names (GOLD.AX, WMC.AX) and copper (STO.AX, CGF.AX) relatively resilient. WA juniors (AUR.AX, GDR.AX, GWP.AX) attract speculative flows.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Iran war/Hormuz risk. Power giants pivoting coal sites to AI data centres. NSW energy security questioned.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike but face transition risk. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (AGL.AX, GPT.AX) creates new revenue but delays decarbonisation.

sectors.trend: Recession fears and private credit stress (Bathla) pressure credit quality. Housing downturn hits mortgage growth. ATO vs Big Tech adds regulatory uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face NIM compression and rising provisions. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by high-end property weakness.

sectors.trend: Healthcare access deteriorating (12-month colonoscopy waits, out-of-pocket costs). Consumer conditions weak. Qantas restructuring signals broader employment stress.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX defensive but face cost pressures. QAN.AX $35m payout signals margin pressure. Tobacco regulation (new laws) impacts consumer discretionary.

sectors.trend: AI data centre demand surging, straining energy transition. Palantir-Nebius sovereign AI partnership signals global trend. ATO targeting Big Tech tax.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from AI capex. Energy infrastructure (SGH.AX, IAG.AX) in demand. Tax risk for foreign tech entities.

key_themes: Geopolitical escalation (Iran war, Hormuz) driving oil to US$100 and risk-off sentiment
Iron ore structural weakness amid China demand deterioration
RBA policy dilemma: recession vs inflation; business conditions at pandemic lows
Housing bifurcation: high-end crash vs affordable resilience; buyer sentiment collapse
WA gold exploration boom; copper/silver exploration active
Energy transition vs AI data centre demand tension

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iran war escalation / Hormuz Strait disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; increase gold allocation; monitor WDS.AX, WLE.AX for oil-driven earnings but cap position size given volatility

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse / China demand weakness
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold/copper miners; monitor China PMI and steel output data
Underweight banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) on provision risk; favour defensive staples (WES.AX, CSL.AX)
Avoid high-end property REITs; monitor GPW.AX, ICPS.AX; favour industrial and healthcare REITs
Review exposure to private credit-linked instruments; monitor bank lending standards and NIM trends

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy security / data centre demand vs transition
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NSW/QLD energy markets; AGL.AX, GPT.AX face policy risk; SGH.AX benefits from infrastructure spend

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and copper miners on safe-haven and structural demand
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical risk, iron ore weakness, and WA exploration pipeline support gold; copper benefits from energy transition and AI data centre buildout

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long oil exposure via ASX energy names
opportunities.rationale: Oil near US$100 on Iran/Hormuz risk; WDS and WLE benefit from price spike but cap exposure given geopolitical volatility

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive rotation into healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Recession fears and weak business conditions favour defensive sectors; CSL and WES offer earnings visibility

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and China-exposed materials weightings
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural downtrend; China-US tensions and weak demand create sustained headwind for BHP, RIO, FMG

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim bank exposure; raise cash or shift to short-duration bonds
defensive_moves.rationale: Recession risk, rising provisions, private credit stress, and housing downturn pressure NIMs and credit quality

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid high-end property and residential REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at top end; buyer sentiment collapsed; $850b coastal housing reckoning underway

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to extend declines on oil spike, iron ore weakness, and risk-off sentiment. RBA recession narrative and Bathla credit stress add pressure. Volatility elevated; expect 3-5% drawdown risk in ^AXJO over 1-3 months.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Iron ore structural shift and China slowdown cap materials recovery. Gold/copper and energy transition names offer relative strength. Housing correction may deepen before stabilising. RBA likely to cut if recession materialises, supporting rate-sensitive sectors eventually.
